question:

(4)/(23), (8)/(17), (3)/(5), (5)/(21)
solution:

(4)/(23), (8)/(17), (3)/(5), (5)/(21)

**Formula Used:**

Compare fractions by converting into decimal values

**Calculation:**

⇒ (4)/(23) ≈ 0.174

⇒ (8)/(17) ≈ 0.471
